what: How long one move takes to score end to end, measured on 100 matched test-split games.
measured_plies_note: Latency was recorded at three game lengths, ply 10, 50 and 100, not continuously, so those three are the only points shown.
cpu_caveat: The CPU arm is a server processor, not a laptop, so treat it as an upper bound on available compute.

budget_reference.name: Bullet, 60+0
budget_reference.note: 60 seconds over about 50 moves per side.

budget_reference.name: Blitz, 300+3
budget_reference.note: 300 seconds over about 50 moves per side.

agreement_note: The live path and offline batch scoring agree exactly at the final ply, to 0.0 rating points on both devices. Per-ply values diverge mid-game by construction, because the offline pass reads the whole game through a bidirectional LSTM.

devices.label: CPU only
devices.hardware: Two Intel Xeon Silver 4309Y at 2.80 GHz, 16 cores and 32 threads in total
